interpretation.headline: Five-language reduced-n HOST screen at shipping quantization.

b5.denominator_interpretation: n=40 per language and n=200 per model across five languages; weaker than the parent plan's per-language requirement

en.wrong_language_eligibility_rule: >=8 Unicode letters; ineligible short answers are excluded

en.bootstrap_method: 10,000-resample stratified percentile bootstrap using one assembly-wide Python random.Random MT19937 stream seeded once at 20260801; model traversal ['qwen35_08b', 'qwen25_15b', 'qwen3_06b', 'falcon_h1_15b'], language traversal ['en', 'zh', 'es', 'fr', 'ru']; within every replicate draw 80 equal-weight MCQ items with replacement before 40 equal-weight generation items; type-7 linear interpolation at 2.5/97.5 percentiles

bootstrap_implementation.partial_pack_state_rule: Unavailable cells consume the same 120 random() values per replicate so every later available cell retains its frozen global-stream position.
bootstrap_implementation.percentile_interpolation: Hyndman-Fan type 7: h=(N-1)*p, linear interpolation between floor(h) and ceil(h), p=0.025/0.975
bootstrap_implementation.seed_scope: Initialized once per complete assembly at seed 20260801; never reset per model-language cell.
bootstrap_implementation.within_replicate_resampling_order: 80 equal-weight MCQ draws with replacement, then 40 equal-weight native-generation draws with replacement

protocol.screen_warning: Reduced-n screen, not n>=1,200 non-inferiority evidence and not native-speaker validation.
